prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right choice depends on what you need (short social clips vs. product demos, live-action avatars vs. animation, budget, number of variations, language/localization). Below are the top options by use case and why you might pick them.

Quick questions to help me recommend one: what platform(s) will you run the ads on (Meta/TikTok/YouTube), what style do you want (real presenter/AI avatar, animated, text+images), and what’s your budget?

Top picks by use case

- Best for AI presenters / talking-head ads: Synthesia
  - Why: realistic multilingual AI avatars, easy script → video, brand customization, enterprise-ready.
  - Good if you want a professional on-screen spokesperson without hiring actors.

- Best for short-form social ads & repurposing (from long videos): Pictory or Vidyo.ai
  - Why: automatically converts long-form content to multiple short clips, auto-captions, templates optimized for social formats.
  - Good for creators repurposing webinars, podcasts, or long livestreams.

- Best general ad-creator with templates and editor: InVideo or Promo.com
  - Why: large template libraries for Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube, easy drag-and-drop editing, stock assets.
  - Good for marketing teams that need quick, polished creatives.

- Best for animated explainer-style ads: Vyond or Biteable
  - Why: strong animation libraries and character rigs, quick to produce explainer ads and product walkthroughs.
  - Good if you want cartoon/animated style rather than live-action.

- Best for scalable ad testing / dynamic creative: Shakr (and ad-tech platforms like VidMob)
  - Why: built for producing large sets of creative variations and integrating with ad platforms for testing.
  - Good when you need hundreds of variants for A/B testing or dynamic ads.

- Best for generative text‑to‑video experimentation: Runway (Gen-2) / Pika Labs
  - Why: advanced generative visuals from text/video prompts; good for creative concepts and unique visuals.
  - Note: still evolving and may need more editing to reach production quality for ads.

- Helpful editing & workflow tools: Descript (edit by text, overdub), CapCut (mobile social edits), Adobe Premiere + AI plugins (for full control)
  - Why: integrate these into workflows for polishing, voiceovers, captions.

How to choose quickly
- Want realistic spokespersons in many languages: Synthesia or HeyGen/Elai.io.
- Repurposing long content into many short ads: Pictory or Vidyo.ai.
- Need lots of on-brand templates and quick edits: InVideo or Promo.com.
- Doing animated explainers: Vyond or Biteable.
- Need massive variant production / dynamic creative: Shakr or VidMob.
- Experimenting with novel visuals: Runway Gen-2 / Pika Labs.

If you tell me: platform, ad length, style (avatar/animation/live-action), and monthly budget (low/mid/high), I’ll recommend one specific tool and suggest a quick workflow or script template.
